subject: SOC 2 packet shared — any blockers on review?
message_1_body:
Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

- I shared our SOC 2 packet (PDF) and a one-tab summary (attached). It includes scope, control owner contacts, and test coverage.
- Action items for FinTechCo: confirm if the scope/cards you need are covered or if you want additional artifacts (audit logs, retention policy, encryption key rotation docs).
- If everything looks good, we can move to the procurement thread and I’ll loop Legal to get the PS/contract drafted (we typically need ~2–3 weeks for enterprise procurement).

I’ve also added the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSOC2-Redwood-2026

If you run into anything blocking the review, please flag it and I’ll escalate to our security team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
